h1: ♀ Venus in Astrology: Love • Taste • Value
subtitle: Domicile: Taurus , Libra • Exaltation: Pisces
summary: Venus in astrology rules love, attraction, aesthetics, pleasure, and the way we give and receive affection; it also governs values, self-worth, and money. In your natal chart, Venus’s sign shows your relational style and tastes, its house pinpoints where you seek harmony and ease, and its aspects reveal patterns in intimacy, compromise, and creative expression. Venus rules Taurus and Libra, so placements or transits affecting these signs strongly influence finances, beauty, partnerships, and social balance. Track Venus transits and retrogrades to time relationships, creative launches, style updates, and financial decisions with greater alignment.

sections.heading: Personality Snapshot
sections.html:
Venus shows what feels good and what’s worth it: how you attract and respond, your taste, generosity, money preferences, and social lubrication. Well-fed Venus makes rooms softer and choices clearer.

✅ What it wants

  • Mutuality, ease, clear appreciation
  • Beauty that matches your values
  • Simple, steady pleasures

⚠️ When it struggles

  • People-pleasing, price-blind spending
  • Jealousy or subtle scorekeeping
  • Comfort as avoidance

🧭 Feed it well

  • Name your yes/no; reward reciprocity
  • Budget for beauty you actually use
  • Practice affection in your dialect

sections.heading: Retrogrades & Cycle (morning/evening star)
sections.html:
Retrograde rhythm

  • Every ~18 months, ~40–43 days
  • Best for relationship & budget reviews
  • Watch aspects (e.g., Venus square Saturn)

Synodic cycle

  • Morning star (bold, fresh starts)
  • Evening star (receptive, integrating)
  • Inferior/superior conjunctions reset themes

House focus

  • Track which house Venus moves through
  • Launch collabs under Venus in your 11th; nest under the 4th
  • Blend with your sign tone
